data.name: Heldritch Rush
data.detailed_description:
New Peak City, 2006. Dr Cooper hits send on her email, “Destroy it all now, before it’s too late”. An automated  response “I am out of office, but I aim to reply within 3 to 5 business days”. The door to her office rips open and she is  consumed. 32 hours later, the city is overrun, 2 million are evacuated, the rest are dead or MIA. The military are quickly pushed back. Teddy MacAllister, receives a call from an old friend “We need your help, soldier”.

Heldritch Rush is an Isometric Rail-shooter set in the future of 2006. Play as Theodore "Teddy" MacAllister as he traverses through a city crawling with what used to be its human population. Teddy is as dumb as a bag of rocks, but he certainly knows how to do his job.

Battle your way through unending hordes of cosmic threats from the zombie-like grunts, leeches who crave nothing but your blood, to giant plant monsters on top of skyscrapers.

Choose how to exterminate in style! With an array of weapons at your disposal, choose which combinations best suit your playstyle. Whether you want precision, lasers, explosions, or lightning, the experience is yours to control.

Pick your direction! Your paths will take you in different directions throughout levels. Find which way is quicker, which way has more enemies, or maybe there is something hidden in the unknown?

Enjoy a fully voice acted experience, full of comedy and thrilling tension that leans on tropes of your favourite action movies and the cliches you know and love.

Now... go out there and kick some ass!

data.short_description: Heldritch Rush is a thrilling, Isometric Rail-shooter set in New Peak City. Play as Teddy MacAllister - an exterminator who is no stranger to the supernatural. Overrun with cosmic threats, battle your way through the city and put an end to the outbreak before the president pushes the big red button.
